title: Week 2 of development - New name, graphics, interface and points taken on board from week ones comments.
author: Enarian__Lead_Dev
selftext:
**Week 2 Video**  
[https://youtu.be/rl5GiqEj1Vg](https://youtu.be/rl5GiqEj1Vg)

This covers commander creation, and the very first mission contract. 

Here was week ones video for those who missed it, thanks for all the comments it was very helpful.  
[https://youtu.be/eSFP6Fl6hpk](https://youtu.be/eSFP6Fl6hpk)

**The premise:**  
You are a fledgling station commander, fresh out of the academy. But no one is going to give you the run of your own station until you have proven yourself.  
  
Fortunately there are plenty of small corporate stations that will be more then happy to hire you when they are threatened by other corporations or pirates.  
  
Mine and salvage ore, and then use that ore to build a fleet from a variety of ship types.  
  
Fighters, Bombers, Frigates, Cruisers all the way up to mighty Carriers and Dreadnaughts.  
  
Complete jobs for various corporations and increase your standings for better rewards, but beware your standing with the opposing faction will take a hit.  
  
Spend hard earned credits on Upgrades to make your fleet more powerful and expand your command to a bigger fleet.  
  
Optional bonus tasks modify the job, making it more challenging but bigger risks, mean bigger rewards...  
  
As the commander of your fleet, you take to the fray in your own ship.  
  
Made up of a loadout comprised of:  
Hull - Sets the type of ship, fighter, frigate etc, armour and hull values and slots for weapons and support.  
Weapons - Pulse Lasers, Beam lasers, Cannons, Missiles and more.  
Support Slots - Tractor beams, Shield Repair lasers etc.  
Engine - Top speed and manoeuvrability.  
Shields - Sets your ships shield capacity.  
  
Upgrades and new items drop as loot from destroyed enemies and from your salvage ships in a variety of rarities. Collect and fit them to boost your power and build the ship you want to command!  
  
Earn exp to level up and unlock higher ranked jobs for better rewards and more loot.

I'd be grateful for any constructive feedback on the direction this week has taken, having been focusing on the core gameplay loop.

\- Added the commander ship and rpg style loot system  
\- Added random events that can occur during missions, such as a fleet of bombers attacking the station from the rear whilst your attention is elsewhere.  
\- Lots of optimisation to get the fps up to a sensible level, also scaled back fleet sizes to make this easier.  
\- Lots of improvements to the ui  
\- New game name and logo.

comments.author: MinimusMaximizer
comments.body: Great looking game so far, what's your asset pipeline and workflow?

replies.author: Enarian__Lead_Dev
replies.body:
Thanks :) 

Almost everything is built in game, so ships, stations etc are all block built so no models etc. So asset wise its pretty simple, Suno for music, sfx from a big pack of sfx I bought from Itch for a different project, graphics generally Firefly. The coding is all done in Cursor.

comments.author: Orinks
comments.body: Curious if you can make this accessible with screen readers? Would take a lot of ideration but I'm sure it could be done. Keep it up and I'll also check out your mud.

replies.author: Enarian__Lead_Dev
replies.body: You can use a third party client to connect for screen readers. I decided that there was no point building it all into the client sincw most people who use them have their own favorite one already.
